card.name: Leading digit of years and decades
card.fires_on: A single digit that starts or sits inside a year, decade or century number, such as the 5 in "the 500s" or the 3 in "the early 30's". It appears in historical or dated narrative after words like in, early, late or during.

modes.label: Decade or century start
modes.description: The first digit of a decade or century, after words like early, late or in the.

modes.label: Digit inside a year
modes.description: A digit in the middle of a four-digit year or date number.

card.writes: It seems to push the model toward continuing the number with more digits, though the promoted tokens are mostly unrelated.
card.plain: It fires on a digit that begins or sits within a year or decade, like the 5 in the 500s.
